verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is itself an official open-source CLI. The evidence documents installation via brew and Docker, subcommands (`github`, `git`, `scan`, `analyze`), and rich flags (`--only-verified`, `--include-detectors`, `--verify-detectors`, `--results`, `--fail`) suited to scripted and automated workflows such as pre-commit hooks, and a probe confirms the official CLI on GitHub. missing for 10: no evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output or other explicitly agent-oriented CLI features, and no independent hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
